title: Product of Array Except Self
oneLinerQuestion: Construct an output array where each index equals the product of all array elements except itself.
explanation: Build prefix products array left to right, then multiply each position by running postfix product from right to left in O(N) time without using division.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION productExceptSelf(nums):
    res = ARRAY_OF_SIZE(LENGTH(nums), INITIAL_VALUE = 1)
    prefix = 1
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(nums) - 1 DO:
        res[i] = prefix; prefix = prefix * nums[i]
    END FOR
    postfix = 1
    FOR i FROM LENGTH(nums) - 1 DOWN TO 0 DO:
        res[i] = res[i] * postfix; postfix = postfix * nums[i]
    END FOR
    RETURN res
END FUNCTION

steps.narration: Line 2-3: Initialize res = [1, 1, 1, 1] and prefix accumulator = 1. Starting prefix pass.
Line 5: i = 0: res[0] = prefix (1). prefix becomes 1 * nums[0] (1) = 1.
Line 5: i = 1: res[1] = prefix (1). prefix becomes 1 * nums[1] (2) = 2.
Line 5: i = 2: res[2] = prefix (2). prefix becomes 2 * nums[2] (3) = 6.
Line 5: i = 3: res[3] = prefix (6). prefix becomes 6 * nums[3] (4) = 24. Prefix pass complete.
Line 7: Start reverse postfix pass: Initialize postfix accumulator = 1.
Line 9: i = 3: res[3] = 6 * postfix(1) = 6. postfix becomes 1 * nums[3](4) = 4.
Line 9: i = 2: res[2] = 2 * postfix(4) = 8. postfix becomes 4 * nums[2](3) = 12.
Line 9: i = 1: res[1] = 1 * postfix(12) = 12. postfix becomes 12 * nums[1](2) = 24.
Line 9: i = 0: res[0] = 1 * postfix(24) = 24. Both passes complete.
Line 11: All elements multiplied by left and right neighbors. RETURN res = [24, 12, 8, 6].

output.label: Products Computed
output.detail: Calculated via two linear passes using O(1) extra space without division.
